projects.title: Voice-Controlled Desktop AI Assistant
projects.outcome: Turns natural, messy speech into validated JSON commands that drive 10+ desktop actions.
projects.problem: Voice control tends to break on natural, messy speech: compound requests, mid-sentence self-corrections, and context-dependent commands like “do that again.”
built: Speech to structured JSON commands via an LLM, executing 10+ system actions: app, file and multi-monitor window control, volume, brightness, power and clipboard.
Handling for compound commands (“open X and then Y”) and self-corrections (“wait, no, actually…”), collapsed into the single intended action.
A validation layer that checks every LLM-generated command against known targets and typed parameter rules before execution, and resolves context-dependent commands from command history.
A React dashboard backed by FastAPI that tracks API usage, command history and quick-action macros.
projects.result: Reduced system prompt size by 55% (9.8K to 4.4K chars) while preserving command accuracy, lowering per-request token cost and latency.

projects.title: Hand-Tracking 3D Controller
projects.outcome: Webcam hand gestures rotate, tilt and zoom a 3D model at sub-100 ms latency.
projects.problem: Controlling a 3D viewer in real time with bare hands and an ordinary webcam.
built: Real-time recognition of pinch, open-palm and fist gestures from a webcam, driving model rotation, tilt and zoom.
Custom directional-movement calculations that map hand-landmark motion between frames to smooth 3D camera transformations.
projects.result: Gesture-driven rotation, tilt and zoom with sub-100 ms latency.

projects.title: 8-Bit CPU & LED Dice PCB
projects.outcome: A simulated 8-bit CPU with a custom instruction set, plus a hand-etched LED dice PCB.
built: A clock-driven 8-bit CPU (ALU, registers, control unit) designed and simulated in Logisim with a custom instruction set.
A physical LED dice PCB, designed in Fritzing, then etched, soldered and validated.
projects.result: Verified correct CPU execution across the custom instruction set; debugged and validated the PCB with bench test equipment.

projects.title: OTAMS Tutor Scheduling App
projects.outcome: Android app for student–tutor scheduling with admin approval and no double-booking.
projects.problem: Students and tutors need to book sessions without conflicts, with admins approving accounts.
built: An Android app for scheduling between students and tutors, with admin approval workflows.
Backend scheduling logic in Cloud Firestore that merges timeslots and prevents double-booking across concurrent bookings.
projects.role: One of a team of 5; built the backend scheduling logic in Cloud Firestore.
projects.result: Timeslots merge automatically and concurrent bookings can't double-book a tutor.

projects.title: Sorcerer's Tower
projects.outcome: A 5-level Java rogue-lite with upgrades, varied enemy AI and a final boss.
built: Movement, aiming and customization systems for a 5-level game.
Progression-based upgrades, varied enemy AI, a final boss and rebindable controls.
projects.result: A complete 5-level rogue-lite built with object-oriented Java.
